timescaledb_extra_params.name: timescaledb.max_open_chunks_per_insert
timescaledb_extra_params.description: Maximum number of chunks to keep open per INSERT operation. Increase if many new chunks are created rapidly.

timescaledb_extra_params.name: timescaledb.enable_chunk_skipping
timescaledb_extra_params.description: Enable chunk exclusion during query planning to improve performance on large datasets.
